svg.title: Assignment statements recognizer: token DFA with dead state
svg.desc: Six grammar states and one absorbing dead state. A complete transition table defines every transition.
svg.text: Token-based DFA / required datatype: int / includes the absorbing dead state
Every unlisted transition from any state goes to qD.
Invalid characters also enter qD. Once there, all remaining input stays there.
All transitions are defined. OTHER includes invalid characters.
* Accept only when input ends in q5. Ending in any other state rejects.
L(L | D)*, except the keyword int
Lexer skips spaces, tabs, and line breaks
between tokens. It never splits a name
or number; tokens use maximal matching.
